review.scope: Public sealed class with the original members. ChannelFactory<SocketChannel>/ChannelFactory<DatagramChannel> are Func<ISocketChannel>/Func<IDatagramChannel>, the factory shape resolver-dns's DnsNameResolverBuilder takes, and EventLoop is IEventLoop; the anonymous ChannelFactory classes of DEFAULT are lambdas. create(...) is Create(...) and checkNotNull is ObjectUtil.CheckNotNull with the original names.

NullPointerException is ArgumentNullException (docs/codec-base-porting.md), so the exception derives from it to keep the "extends NullPointerException for backwards compatibility" relation; the message-only constructor passes a null parameter name through ArgumentNullException(string paramName, string message).

Bouncy Castle (bcpkix) OCSP types are the CLR-only replacements of OcspAsn1.cs on System.Formats.Asn1 (CertificateID, OCSPReqBuilder, OCSPResp, BasicOCSPResp, SingleResp, RevokedStatus, UnknownStatus, Extension); OCSPException, OperatorCreationException and CertificateException are CryptographicException, IllegalStateException InvalidOperationException and IllegalArgumentException ArgumentException. Promise<T> is TaskCompletionSource<T> and each listener a continuation on Common's EventExecutorTaskScheduler over the IoTransport's event loop. java.net.URL is Uri (URL.getPath() keeps its empty result for a URL without a path); AuthorityInformationAccess is the BCL's X509AuthorityInformationAccessExtension.EnumerateOcspUris(), which skips non-URI locations. The JDK CertPathBuilder (PKIX, TrustAnchor = issuer) is an X509Chain built with the response certificates and the issuer in its ExtraStore, the path being the elements before the first element that matches the issuer by name and key: a PKIX anchor can be any CA certificate, while the Windows chain engine reports PartialChain for an intermediate CA in a CustomTrustStore (measured with validateSignatureWithIncludedChainSucceeds and the apple.com responder). X500Principal.equals is equal DER or equal decoded names ignoring case, and PublicKey.equals equal SubjectPublicKeyInfo. As in Java, a response whose BasicOCSPResponse cannot be decoded sets the failure with the null cause of the successful future, so the response promise stays incomplete (kept; see docs/handler-ssl-ocsp-porting.md).

notPorted.sourceContract: Public abstract ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter (@UnstableApi) that takes a ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine, removes itself on the SslHandshakeCompletionEvent and throws SSLHandshakeException("Bad OCSP response") when verify(ctx, engine) rejects the stapled OCSP response of ReferenceCountedOpenSslEngine.getOcspResponse().

review.scope: Internal sealed ChannelDuplexHandler. Promise<OCSPResp> is TaskCompletionSource<OcspResp> (OcspAsn1.cs) and OCSPException CryptographicException; the listener that cancels the timeout runs synchronously when the promise completes, and Future<?> timeoutFuture is the CancellationTokenSource of ctx.Executor.ScheduleAsync, as handler's AbstractSniHandler. write(ctx, msg, promise) is WriteAsync returning the Task of the base write. status() == OK stays a reference comparison; equalsIgnoreCase is an ordinal case-insensitive comparison; ClosedChannelException is Transport's.

java.util.Date is DateTimeOffset and the optional nextUpdate a nullable DateTimeOffset; checkNotNull of the enum and thisUpdate has no counterpart for value types. status() is Status_() because a method cannot share the nested Status enum's name (pkitesting's Algorithm_ precedent); the enum keeps VALID/REVOKED/UNKNOWN. toString() formats the dates as Date.toString() does, in UTC with the invariant culture.

ByteToMessageDecoder implementing IChannelOutboundHandler with the original constructors, fields and flow. engine().getSession().getPeerCertificates() is SslHandler.PeerCertificates(), an internal CLR-only accessor added to Netty.NET.Handler (InternalsVisibleTo Netty.NET.Handler.Ssl.Ocsp) that returns the chain SslStream built for the remote certificate, captured in the validation callback; SslHandler.engine() is not public (docs/handler-ssl-design.md). Promise<BasicOCSPResp> is TaskCompletionSource<BasicOcspResp> with its listener on EventExecutorTaskScheduler over ctx.Executor. Date/currentTimeMillis are DateTimeOffset/UtcNow, and thisUpdate == null has no counterpart (thisUpdate is a required field). AttributeKey<Boolean> is AttributeKey<object> with a boxed bool, as resolver-dns's DNS_PIPELINE_ATTRIBUTE. OCSPException is CryptographicException and IllegalStateException InvalidOperationException. The protected static createDefaultResolver has the internal forwarder InvokeCreateDefaultResolver for the tests, as handler-proxy's InvokeNewInitialMessage.
Public sealed class; response() is Response() and toString() ToString().
